name: NoSeriesDraw
caption: Draw number from number series

configuration.description: Code of the No. Series to draw from (e.g. 'S-ORD'), or a SmartField that yields it. Cut to 20 characters at runtime.
Date that selects the No. Series Line (Starting Date). Empty = work date. A literal date or a SmartField; parsed with the session's regional date format (not invariant).

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while noSeriesCode is empty (a SmartField placeholder counts as filled).
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: Codes longer than 20 characters are cut to 20 at runtime, so the wrong series (or none) is used.
A non-empty usageDate (after SmartField resolution) must parse as a date in the session's format.
rules.message: The usage date "%1" is not a valid date.

rules.check: The No. Series must exist (an unresolved {{token}} stays in the text and fails here).
rules.message: The number series %1 does not exist.

rules.check: The series must allow drawing for the date (default numbers allowed, a series line valid for the date, not exhausted). Business Central's own No. Series error is raised.

notes: The output name is 'Number' (capital N) - reference it as {{slug_Number}}.
The editor's default description is the short caption 'Draw Number'; once a series is chosen it becomes 'Draw Number from <code>'. The enum caption is 'Draw number from number series'.
The number is consumed: the series' last-used number is advanced when the step runs, so each run yields a new number.
usageDate is parsed with the regional date format of the session that runs the flow (there is no invariant/9 option here). Leave it empty unless the series has date-dependent lines.
Writing step: a Confirm dialog placed after this step (in document order) produces a publish warning, because Business Central cannot open a dialog once the flow has written to the database.
